gaps.explanation: The General Fund Schedule of Expenditures (p14) prints 'Debt Service and bond issue cost' 1,626,815.70 (Street column) as an expenditure (detail line 'Debt service - Bond issue costs' 1,626,815.70, p14). The governmental funds statement (p5) prints the same amount as 'Note Payment' (1,626,815.70) under Other Financing Sources (Uses), not among expenditures. Detail expenditure lines on p14 add to 2,772,884.66 less Transfers out 60,000.00 (other financing) = 2,712,884.66; statement expenditure lines (p4) add to 1,086,068.96; 2,712,884.66 - 1,086,068.96 = 1,626,815.70 exactly. Both are printed this way (as-printed rule), so no fix. (Separately, both p4 Total expenditures 1,086,218.96 and p14 Total 2,773,034.66 are 150.00 above their lines; that error is the report's own and cancels in this comparison.)

Proprietary statement (p9) prints Miscellaneous 89.75 in the nonmajor (Other) column; the Nonmajor Proprietary Funds Combining Statement (p15) prints no Miscellaneous row, but its Waste column Total operating expenses 196,471.50 is 89.75 above its printed lines (196,381.75), while the Ambulance column lines add exactly to 138,991.96. So the 89.75 Miscellaneous belongs to the Waste Fund and is missing from detail. Schedule 1,789,498.74 + 89.75 = 1,789,588.49 = statement total.
